title: Company raw fundamentals
description: One company's raw financial fundamentals as sourced (QuoteMedia today, PDF/LLM extraction later). Deliberately NOT a GuruFocus rank/score profile -- no Financial Strength / Profitability Rank / GF Value / Piotroski / analyst-estimate sections. Just identity plus the per-year income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement line items exactly as stored, so nothing is invented or null-padded. Computed ratios/ranks are a later phase.

financials.description: One entry per fiscal year, most-recent first.

statement.description: Raw line items, keyed by the source's own field name (e.g. TotalRevenue, NetIncome, TotalAssets, OperatingCashFlow). Open object -- whatever the source reported for this company/year, nothing invented.
